item.title: 07227P0001-Modernized Commissary Operations
item.description:
Correction | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-12-07 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Correction is seeking proposals from vendors to supply, store, package and deliver individualized commissary orders for people in its custody, with responses due Dec. 7, 2026, and a pre-proposal conference set for Nov. 9, 2026.

The New York City Department of Correction is requesting proposals for an all-purpose commissary vendor to supplement and modernize operations. The selected vendor would supply, store, fulfill, package, and deliver individualized commissary orders for Person-In Custody (hence forth referred to as PIC). There will be a Highly Recomended Pre-Proposal Conference for this solicitation on Monday, November 9, 2026 at 10:00 A.M. item.title: 07227B0002-On-Call Mechanical Equipment and Systems
item.description:
Correction | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-10-30 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Correction is seeking bids from contractors for on-call repairs, diagnostics, preventive maintenance and replacement of mechanical equipment and systems at its facilities, with responses due Oct. 30, 2026.

The Department of Correction is seeking the service of a contractor to provide On-call, as necessary repairs/diagnostic services, preventive maintenance and replacement of mechanical equipment and systems deemed to be beyond repair or beyond their useful life for varieties DOC facilities. This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx) is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal at https://cityshare.nycnet/content/buywise/pages/passport and click on the Procurement Navigator. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 07227B0002 into the Keywords search field. If you need assistance submitting a response, please contact the Mayor's Office of Contracts (MOCS helpdesk) at https://mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8

Pre-Bid Meeting Information - Tuesday, October 6, 2026 11:00 AM 12:00 PM (EDT) Join on your computer, mobile app or room device https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/248164915694391?p=AnUCLJMw6Q7fPNZS8o Meeting ID: 2…

item.title: Willo Alarms and Locking Mechanisms
item.description:
Correction | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-09-16 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Correction intends to award a sole source contract to Willo Products Company, LLC, for alarms and locking mechanisms used to maintain and upgrade detention locking systems, with responses due Sept. 16, 2026.

In accordance with Procurement Policy Board Rule Section 3-05, the New York City Department of Correction (DOC) intends to enter into a sole source agreement with Willo Products Company, LLC. The purpose of this agreement is to procure alarms and locking mechanisms vital to the ongoing maintenance and upgrade of the DOCs detention locking systems.
 

The DOC is currently replacing and upgrading cell doors throughout its facilities to comply with modern correctional standards. This procurement will encompass high security locking systems, including the Wedge, Tamper Alarm, Gripper, and High-intensity LED light Lock Receivers.

Willo Products Company LLC is the original developer and manufacturer of these patented systems.  Willo Products Company LLC does not authorize the production or…
